articles.title: BNY in talks with Kraken parent Payward over infrastructure partnership
articles.snippet: The potential agreement could span digital assets, custody, trading, payments and other financial-market infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
articles.snippet: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly hits $87K as weak US jobs data sends bond yields lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin climbed after weaker-than-expected payrolls pushed Treasury yields lower, but order-book resistance kept BTC from reaching new macro highs.

articles.title: ‘Euro stablecoin isn’t enough’: EU issuers make case for USD tokens
articles.snippet: European issuers say Europe cannot ignore demand for dollar stablecoins as businesses seek USD liquidity for global payments and settlement.

articles.title: CONNECT recap: Arthur Hayes on money printing, Wall Street moves onchain
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes said money printing could lift crypto prices, while CONNECT Seoul speakers examined Wall Street’s competitive edge onchain.
